summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed Form 6-K to respond to a media report regarding a potential acquisition of Lotte Insurance, as published by The Korea Economic Daily on June 29, 2026. The filing states that the company is currently reviewing various measures to enhance non-bank competitiveness, but no final decision has been made regarding the acquisition. The matter remains under review, and additional disclosure will be provided once details are determined or within one month. This is a routine response to rumors, not a definitive special situation.
